section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that in the month of Nissan, the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof is manifest, and therefore no intercalation of the year is needed.
section.t: And this is “This month is for you the head of months,”
that in the month of Nissan is the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof.
And this is that when Rosh Chodesh Nissan arrives, we do not intercalate the year,
for the aspect of “year” is in the light that relates to the worlds,
and since the drawing down of this light is through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin,
we intercalate the year as needed so that the elevation of Mayin Nukvin will be in its proper manner,
therefore, when Rosh Chodesh Nissan arrives,
[being] the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof that is above arousal from below,
we do not intercalate the year,
as is explained at length in the maamar [note 36].
And this is also that the month of Nissan is the month of redemption,
for in Nissan they were redeemed and in Nissan they are destined to be redeemed [note 37],
for the concept of redemption is that then “your Teacher will no longer be hidden” [note 38],
the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof without any garment [note 39].

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section expresses the wish that all this be fulfilled speedily in the month of Nissan of this very year, with joy and feasting.
section.t: May it be His will that all this be speedily, in our very own days,
in the month of Nissan of this very year,
and we will eat there from the offerings and from the Paschal sacrifices [note 40],
amidst joy and a good heart.
